_comment: Legal corpus — projects every gate must ACCEPT.
build:<design> means 'produce it with scripts/build.js first'; dir:<path> means 'a project
already committed in this repo'. key is the baseline id the illegal variants clone from.
A build entry must exit 0 and show 0 validate errors and 0 ERC errors.
formatOnly: true is for projects this skill did not author: the FORMAT gate must accept
them, their circuit is out of scope (their ERC findings are printed, not asserted).
Maintainers: run `node test/corpus.js --probe` to see what each gate reports.

legal.note: the reference design: schematic + PCB, routed and poured, every gate clean
